title: Secretly scheming the three-day Heavenly Secrets
next_chapter_hook: That mysterious signal was like a solitary lamp in the darkness, guiding Chen Ji toward a corner he had never known existed—just what secrets lay hidden there?

text.content:
The night was as dark as ink. Deep within the dense forest behind the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji's silhouette darted between ancient trees like a specter. It had been only the time needed to burn a stick of incense since he left Ye Qing, yet he had already surveyed the terrain for several li in every direction. Moonlight filtered through the gaps in the branches, casting mottled shadows across his face—alternating between bright and dark, his eyes remained as cold and still as an ancient deep well.

He leaned against the thick trunk of a century-old pine, slowly drawing from his chest a scroll of yellowed fragments—the first page of the Tianji Record. The patterns on the fragment glowed faintly in the night, like a slumbering beast breathing.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) Three days' deadline... Ye Qing, you think you're the one setting the trap, but little do you know, you were already part of the game.

text.content:
The moment his words fell, a line of tiny characters suddenly appeared on the Tianji Record Fragment. The ink moved like a living thing, ultimately coalescing into an ancient, simple script—that was Mo Xiansheng's voice. This remnant soul guardian communicated with Chen Ji in such a covert manner; every time knowledge was unsealed, it was like dancing on the edge of a blade.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, staring at the line of characters, his pupils reflecting the faint spiritual light. He knew another five points of Heavenly Fate would be deducted, but to spy on Ye Qing's movements over these three days—it was a worthwhile trade.

dialogue.content: (The remnant soul whispers) Boy, peering into heavenly secrets comes with a price. Your Heavenly Fate is now below a hundred points. Keep squandering it like this, and death won't be far behind.
(A cold smile curling at the corner of his lips) Death? Before my scheme is complete, no one will make me die. Begin.

text.content:
Chen Ji bit open his right index finger, letting a drop of crimson blood fall onto the fragment. In an instant, the Tianji Record awakened like an ancient fierce beast. After devouring the blood, it erupted with blinding golden light. That light was almost tangible, piercing into Chen Ji's Brow Center, bringing a splitting, excruciating pain.

His pupils suddenly dilated, the world before him began to twist and tear apart—scenes from three hours later flooded into his mind like a tide.

In the vision, Ye Qing was leading several experts from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path deep into a secret realm. That realm was shrouded in mist and clouds, ancient architectural ruins flickering in and out of sight, the air permeated with a chilling forbidden energy. Ye Qing's expression was grave; she had clearly sensed the danger of this secret realm, but for the sake of something, she had to risk pressing forward.

Chen Ji watched all this within the illusion, the curve of his lips growing increasingly icy. He was gambling—gambling on how much Ye Qing valued him, gambling that she would definitely send someone to investigate him, and that the investigation site would be precisely that fake fortune he had deliberately leaked.

However, the scene suddenly shifted. Deep within the secret realm, an altar sealed for ten thousand years slowly opened. Above the altar, countless mechanism puppets stirred like awakened venomous snakes, their icy gazes locking onto Ye Qing's group. The attack came without warning; the foremost Demonic Path expert didn't even have time to react before a fierce sword qi pierced through his chest.

Blood splattered, staining Ye Qing's sleeve. A flash of astonishment crossed her face, then transformed into icy killing intent.

dialogue.content: (In the vision, Ye Qing growls) Damn it! Who leaked our whereabouts? This is clearly a trap set for me!

text.content:
Chen Ji saw this and his spirit surged. The vision continued: although Ye Qing was powerful, she gradually became exhausted under the siege of the secret realm's mechanisms. Although her 'Demonic Path Mist' could conceal her aura, it couldn't ward off physical attacks.

More importantly—Chen Ji saw something in the vision. Deep within the altar, there was a stone gate sealed by layers of formations. Ancient runes were carved on that stone gate, runes he had never seen before, yet they gave him a strange sense of familiarity.

Just then, the vision violently twisted, and the Tianji Record's backlash arrived as expected. A sharp pain exploded from his Brow Center, as if ten thousand fine needles were simultaneously piercing his brain. Chen Ji groaned, fine threads of blood seeping from his seven orifices, his whole body swaying.

He gripped the tree trunk, gasping heavily, cold sweat sliding down his temples. Heavenly Fate—another five points lost. But all of this was worth it.

dialogue.content: (Gasping, he whispers) What clever secret realm mechanisms... Ye Qing, you think I'm playing cat and mouse with you? Wrong. I intend to force you into accepting my help in a desperate situation.

text.content:
Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, but his eyes grew even clearer. He had already sketched out the complete scheme in his mind—under the siege of the secret realm's mechanisms, Ye Qing would inevitably suffer heavy losses. Then he would appear as someone 'passing by coincidentally' and offer assistance, using the grace of saving her life to earn her trust.

However, this wasn't his true purpose. What he truly wanted was that sealed stone gate deep within the altar.

Just as Chen Ji was about to leave, his gaze inadvertently swept across the century-old pine behind him. His pupils constricted sharply—on the trunk, when had several thin-as-hair carvings appeared? Those carvings seemed randomly scattered, but if connected, they formed an ancient rune.

That rune was exactly the same as the one on the stone gate he had seen in the vision.

dialogue.content: (His pupils slightly dilating) This is... a signal left by someone?

text.content:
Chen Ji crouched down, carefully examining those carvings. His fingers gently traced the edge of the wood shavings, the texture cool, carrying a faint spiritual energy fluctuation—this was by no means something an ordinary person could leave. Every line of the carvings was precise, as if carved by invisible sword qi, the force perfectly controlled—neither harming the trunk in the slightest nor failing to completely present the rune.

Whoever could do this was no ordinary person.

Chen Ji stood up, his gaze sweeping across the surrounding dense forest. The night wind brushed through the treetops, rustling, besides this, absolute silence. No figure, no aura, as if the person who left this signal had never existed.

But he knew—there were eyes watching him from the shadows. The master of those eyes clearly knew many things—including the Tianji Record, including Ye Qing, and perhaps even the whereabouts of his sister Chen Nian.

Who exactly was this person?

Just as Chen Ji was deep in thought, a faint spiritual energy fluctuation emanated from the rune. That fluctuation was fleeting, yet it sketched a clear path in his mind—following this path, he would find where the rune pointed.

There perhaps lay the key to changing everything.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, tucking the Tianji Record Fragment back into his chest. He raised his head, gazing at the pitch-black night sky, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips.

text.content:
Chen Ji moved forward along the direction the rune indicated, his steps soundless yet firm. In the night, his figure was like a ghost merging with the darkness, passing through ancient tree after ancient tree. With each step, he could feel that faint spiritual energy fluctuation guiding him.

This feeling was peculiar—like someone had lit a lamp for him in the darkness, yet refused to reveal themselves.

After about half a stick of incense's time, Chen Ji arrived at the entrance of a hidden valley. The valley mouth was concealed by layers of vines; without the rune's guidance, it would have been impossible to discover this place held something extraordinary. He pushed aside the vines, and what met his eyes made his pupils contract sharply—

In the valley stood an ancient stone tablet, still and solemn. That same mysterious rune was carved on the tablet, and below the rune were a line of small characters:

'The chess game has begun; a move made cannot be undone.'

choices.text: Ignore for now, focus on the scheme
choices.description: The most urgent matter now is dealing with Ye Qing's investigation; the mysterious person's signal can be checked later. Steady and sure, no recklessness.
choices.visible_reward: Keep the plan executing step by step
choices.risk_hint: If the mysterious person intentionally hides, missing this chance may make it difficult to find them again

text.content:
Chen Ji pondered for a moment, finally suppressing the impulse to investigate. That the mysterious person could leave a signal behind him without him knowing indicated the other's strength was深不可测. Before getting a clear picture of the other's background, recklessly pursuing would be nothing short of walking into a trap.

He firmly记住了 the rune's location in his heart, then turned and left. What mattered most now was ensuring Ye Qing entered his trap; everything else could be dealt with gradually.

Upon returning to his lodging, Chen Ji immediately began perfecting his plan. He took out a sheepskin scroll, using special spirit ink to outline the layout of the secret realm. The positions of those mechanism puppets, their power ranges, their attack rhythms—he had seen them clearly in the vision, all now brought vividly to life on the paper.

Three days later, he would personally appear at that secret realm, saving Ye Qing from danger as someone 'coincidentally passing by.'

choices.description: Since someone is observing him in secret, why not turn the tables—set traps along the path of investigating the signal, and see if we can counter the mysterious person.
choices.visible_reward: May counter the mysterious person and obtain more intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Since the mysterious person dared to leave a signal, they must have backup plans

text.content:
An idea quickly formed in Chen Ji's mind. He pretended to pursue along the direction of the rune, his footsteps deliberately heavy, his spiritual energy fluctuation also released on purpose—a display of eagerness to investigate.

In reality, he quietly set up several hidden spiritual sensing arrays along the way. These formations were extremely faint, undetectable by ordinary cultivators, but could transmit information back to his Tianji Record Fragment when someone passed through.

Indeed, when Chen Ji reached the valley entrance, the Tianji Record Fragment grew slightly warm. He stopped, pretending to examine the stone tablet, while in truth his mind was immersed in the information transmitted by the fragment—

Someone had followed him. Moreover, just moments ago, this person had lingered at the location where he had set up his first sensing array for a full ten breaths. During those ten breaths, this person seemed to be hesitating, seemed to be confirming something.

In the end, this person still did not enter the range of the second formation.

As Chen Ji left the valley, his steps were light yet carried an inexplicable certainty. The mysterious person's signal and the words on the stone tablet's inscription echoed repeatedly in his mind—'The chess game has begun; a move made cannot be undone.'

These words were profound. Chess game meant someone was scheming; a move made meant someone had already begun action. And that mysterious person was clearly both observer and participant.

Chen Ji raised his head, gazing at the eastern horizon gradually brightening. The three-day deadline was approaching; Ye Qing's investigation was about to begin, and the net he had meticulously woven was about to reap its harvest.

But apart from all this, the existence of that mysterious person was like a thorn lodged in his heart. Someone in the shadows was helping him—this was beyond doubt—otherwise that signal wouldn't have pointed to the similar rune on the altar's stone gate, that mysterious person wouldn't have known he would come to the Back Mountain, and wouldn't have left that profound message.

But the question was: Who exactly was this person? Friend or foe? Why help him?

Chen Ji didn't know the answer. But he had grown accustomed to moving forward through fog. 'The chess game has begun; a move made cannot be undone'—since this contest had already begun, he would see it through to the end.

When Chen Ji returned to his lodging, the sky had already begun to lighten. He closed the door, taking the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest. The ink on the fragment had already faded, leaving only that yellowed blankness, silent and ancient.

He gently stroked the edge of the fragment, his fingertips feeling the rough texture left by years. Mo Xiansheng's voice seemed to ring in his ear, carrying a warning tone: every glimpse of heavenly secrets drains one's life; every step toward truth brings one closer to death.

But so what?

For the sake of finding his sister Chen Nian, for the sake of breaking free from being manipulated in this heavenly chess game, for the sake of making those who treated him as a chess piece pay the price—even if the path ahead was a bottomless abyss, he would step down without hesitation.

Chen Ji put away the Tianji Record Fragment, lying back on that simple wooden bed. Outside the window, the sky grew brighter and brighter; disciples in the sect began their day's work. The sweeping sounds of servants, the morning training of disciples, the occasional beast roars—all seemed so ordinary, as if the undercurrents of last night had never happened.

But Chen Ji knew—a storm was coming.

Three days later, he would meet Ye Qing at that secret realm. At that time, he would personally pull this Holy Sect Saint of the Demonic Path into his chess game, making her a crucial piece in his fight against the Tianqing Sect and against the Eye of Heaven.

As for that mysterious person's signal... after dealing with Ye Qing's matters, he would investigate it then.

With this thought, Chen Ji closed his eyes, falling into a light sleep.
